question: In ______, Gandhiji held a Satyagraha at Ahmedabad to solve the dispute between the owners and workers of a cotton mill in the city.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1918.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gandhiji **held a Satyagraha at Ahmedabad to solve the **dispute between the owners and workers of a cotton mill in the city in 1918.**
 
• This **Satyagraha **was known as the **Ahmedabad Mill Strike** and was one of the biggest labor strikes in the history of India 
 
• The workers of the mill demanded better working conditions, higher wages, and the right to form a union, which were denied by the mill owners.
 
• **Gandhiji**, who was already a well-known leader of the **Indian National Congress**, supported the workers' cause and encouraged them to use non-violent means to achieve their demands.
 
• The **Satyagraha **lasted for about a month and ended with a settlement between the workers and the mill owners, which included an increase in wages and better working conditions.
